headline: Hackers steal API keys from AI coding tool OpenCode
summary: Hackers breached part of OpenCode's platform, an open-source AI coding tool, stealing API keys from a small number of users and running up charges on their AI accounts. One report links the breach to AI distillation attacks; another notes that AI tools asked to review the malicious code kept refusing to look at it.

claims.statement: Hackers breached OpenCode's platform and stole some users' API keys used with external providers.

sources.quote: OpenCode has notified a small number of users that API keys they used with external providers were exposed in a security breach
